undertale_death_screen.config.shard_rend:
Canta i malle i rácina hón.
  Cuina: I hón cuina lá pelë.
  Pelinwa: I hón pelë lá cuina.
undertale_death_screen.config.centered_h: I hón cuina endanna nó rácë.
undertale_death_screen.config.dynamicHea:
Ahya i hón cala yá:
 - Hloirë
 - Hestë
 - Ringë
undertale_death_screen.config.vanilla_fa: I firil cala tuluva yá rácë.
undertale_death_screen.config.text_fade_: Will the 'You died!' text fade in smoothly after the animation.
Duration of the text fade in in ticks (20 = 1 second).
undertale_death_screen.config.fade_to_va: Will the black background fade out.
Speed at which the black background dissolves.
undertale_death_screen.config.fixed_anim: If enabled, the animation will run at a fixed 60 FPS.
undertale_death_screen.config.disable_bu: If enabled, you will not be able to click buttons before the animation ends.
undertale_death_screen.config.disable_va: Disables the vanilla red tint around the edges of the screen after death animation.
undertale_death_screen.config.independen: Ae tiri, i lindë gurth-diliant ú-bendra i lindë-caw, a bendratha er i taur-caw.
undertale_death_screen.config.preview_on: If ON, closing the config menu will instantly trigger a fake death screen to preview your settings.
